Management Plan

- Diagnosis of likely contact dermatitis, likely related to occupational chemical exposure.
- Recommend strict avoidance of triggers: wear gloves consistently when cleaning.
- Prescribed topical steroid cream and stronger moisturizing emollients (specific names/doses not documented).

- Patient advised to return for follow-up if no improvement after 1–2 weeks or if symptoms worsen or spread.
- Prescription to be sent to patient’s pharmacy.
- Provided education regarding trigger avoidance and when to seek further review.
